summary: The page fits the viewport in RTL light theme, but contains unmirrored breadcrumb separators and low-contrast secondary text within the dialog cards.

issues.title: Unmirrored breadcrumb separators
issues.description: Breadcrumb chevron separators point right instead of left for RTL navigation flow.
issues.evidence: The '>' separators between items point toward the starting item.
issues.suggestion: Mirror separator chevrons to point left in RTL mode.

issues.title: Low contrast metadata text
issues.description: Secondary monospace description text in pricing cards lacks sufficient contrast against the white surface.
issues.evidence: Text reading 'liquid glass surface material...' is faint light gray on white background.
issues.suggestion: Increase font weight or darken text color to meet contrast thresholds.
